label: Denmark
trip: One trip, October 2021, four days, part of an Amsterdam > Copenhagen > London trip (the journal heads these entries '2020', but the weekday headings, the photo dates and the field notes all say 2021). Mon Oct 18: fly Amsterdam > Copenhagen (Norwegian), Airbnb in Copenhagen V (Vesterbro), dinner at Kebabistan. Tue Oct 19: Nyhavn, smørrebrød, Rosenborg Castle, the Botanical Garden, Torvehallerne, the Round Tower, Superkilen, Christiania, dinner at Restaurant Klubben. Wed Oct 20: day trip by train to Malmö (Sweden): Lilla Torg, Bullen, Form Design Center, Konditori Katarina, Slottsträdgården, Malmö Castle; back to Copenhagen for Smagsløget sandwiches. Thu Oct 21: Ny Carlsberg Glyptotek (the rainy day), Broens Gadekøkken, fly Copenhagen > London Heathrow (SAS)

albums.Copenhagen, Amsterdam & London (2021): shared album; Denmark is Oct 18 (evening) to Oct 21, 2021: Copenhagen Oct 19 (~50 photos) and Oct 21 morning (~6), Malmö (Sweden) Oct 20 (~14). Oct 16-18 daytime is Amsterdam, Oct 21 evening to 23 is London: never use those for Denmark. The photos carry no GPS; go by capture date and what is in the frame
